system.description:
A mercenary tradition with no fixed guild: travelling contracts and a reputation. You answer to no owl, no council, no creed.

  • Mounted Strike: a creature your mount moved past this turn counts as unable to see you for your Sneak Attack.
    • 9th level: after a Sneak Attack while mounted, your mount may move 15ft without provoking.
  • Open Contract: Advantage on checks to establish your credentials and negotiate terms with new clients.
